I've been looking into a way to receive news on discounted games in an automated fashion such as RSS or emails, but have been reluctant to find them specific for Linux gaming. What do you guys use?
Do you receive Steam Deals / GoG Deals Notifications?

I haven't used it extensively myself - so take this with a grain of salt - but have you tried the Gaming on Linux Sale Page? It looks like they've got it RSS-able.

Personally, I use a combination of /r/linuxgaming, /v/linuxgaming, and one or two twitter accounts to keep me in-the-know. Also, when I see a game on Steam that might be to my liking, I add it to my wishlist. Steam will periodically email you when a game on your wishlist is on sale (though I have yet to figure out the frequency or what triggers it).

If you know what games you want, isthereanydeal.com is awesome. It searches whichever sites you want for the games you want and will email you when they are on sale or in a bundle. If you ignore the sale, it automatically sets a threshold, so you won't be notified unless it drops below the price of the ignored sale. It imports your wish list from Steam, and I believe GOG and others too. It also shows historical data, so you know if it's worth it to wait for a better sale, etc.
